title: DONNELLY, Fr Seán: Death
textSnippet: DONNELLY, Fr Seán: Death Death 431 --> Published in the Irish Times on 11th February 2009 DONNELLY, Fr Seán (Kilkenny and late of Limerick, Spokane and Florida) - February 10, 2009, peacefully, in the loving care of the staff in Drakelands Nursing Home, son of the late Kathleen and John and brother of the late Mossy. He will be sadly missed by his brother Br. Felix, sisters Moira Leonard (Dublin) and Ita Scott (Kilkenny), relatives and friends. Rest in peace. Funeral prayers this (Wednesday) evening at 6.30 o'clock in Hehir's Funeral Home followed by removal to St Canice's Church. Funeral tomorrow (Thursday) after 11 o'clock Mass to Kilbride Cemetery, Callan, Co. Kilkenny. Jeggo. David : Obituary... Jeggo.
